status: post-primary bounded secondary analysis; not preregistered confirmatory evidence

reviewer_revision.status: reviewer-requested post-primary analysis; definitions fixed after external manuscript review
reviewer_revision.purpose: Expose sealed family heterogeneity, test sensitivity to the small frozen strata, repeat the support-reallocation diagnostic on the sealed samples, and document one illustrative RTL/PPA contrast without changing the primary endpoint.

invariants.primary_endpoint: mean per-design equal-sample post-route Fmax; incorrect samples and implementation failures score 0 MHz

direct_rf_mlp.scope: all sealed designs, plus frozen interpolation and extrapolation regimes
direct_rf_mlp.effect: paired per-design RF minus MLP penalized equal-sample Fmax
direct_rf_mlp.resample_plan: reuse the immutable Study 2 primary plan

resource_power.conditioning: within each design and arm, multiplicity-weighted over oracle-correct candidates that compiled successfully
resource_power.common_support: include a design in the three-arm resource table only when all three arms have at least one compiled correct sample
resource_power.uncertainty: paired family-by-regime stratified bootstrap absolute differences using the frozen Study 2 plan restricted to common support
resource_power.power_limitation: Vivado vectorless estimate, not measured board power
resource_power.failure_rule: never assign zero area or power to an incorrect or failed sample; report correctness and synthesis coverage beside conditional PPA

family_breakdown.scope: point estimates on the immutable sealed RF-versus-SFT endpoint
family_breakdown.uncertainty: none; family sample sizes are too small for stable family-level intervals

unstratified_sensitivity.effect: paired per-design RF minus SFT penalized equal-sample Fmax
unstratified_sensitivity.reporting: sensitivity only; does not replace the frozen stratified primary interval

leave_one_family_out.effect: unweighted mean paired RF minus SFT effect after omitting each family in turn
leave_one_family_out.reporting: range across the five omissions; descriptive sensitivity

sealed_support.support_test: SFT contains a compiled correct candidate with measured Fmax at least the RF multiplicity-weighted conditional-on-correct mean, tolerance 1e-6 MHz
sealed_support.effective_support: inverse-Simpson count over distinct oracle-correct strings after normalizing their multiplicities conditional on correctness
sealed_support.reporting: mechanism diagnostic, not a causal test

illustrative_rtl_case.selection_status: post-review illustrative case chosen for an interpretable direct-form versus registered transposed-form contrast; not a preregistered representative sample
illustrative_rtl_case.reporting: source-level example only; no population or causal inference

reporting_rules: The preregistered RF-versus-SFT endpoint remains the only primary claim.
Direct RF-versus-MLP and conditional resource/power results are secondary.
A direct RF-versus-MLP superiority claim requires its paired confidence interval to exclude zero.
Conditional PPA claims must state their common-support design count and vectorless-power limitation.
Reviewer-requested family, sensitivity, support, and RTL-case analyses must be labeled post-primary and descriptive.
No further training, seeds, checkpoint selection, or sealed-sample additions are authorized by this analysis.
